get.description:
Each persisted state of the operation, starting with the current one, until it finishes.
Notifications only: the REST resource stays authoritative, and reconnecting never repeats work.

DamagedOperation.title: DamagedOperation
DamagedOperation.description:
An operation file that cannot be read. It is never modified or skipped: whether its work reached the
project is unknown until someone checks, so model work waits until the file is moved aside.

attempts.title: Attempts
attempts.description: Requests submitted, including any repeated automatically or cut off.

ambiguousAttempts.title: Ambiguousattempts
ambiguousAttempts.description: Requests that may have been processed and charged although no usable answer came back.

cost.title: Cost
cost.description: Credits reported across all attempts. Empty unless one was reported and none is unknown.

costStatus.title: Coststatus
costStatus.description: unknown when any attempt's cost is unknown, including one that may have been charged; not-charged when every attempt was rejected before a model processed it.

Operation.title: Operation
Operation.description: The public state of one model operation, also sent as each SSE notification.

Problem.title: Problem
Problem.description: An RFC 9457 problem with this API's extension members.

questionId.title: Questionid
questionId.description: The question the user chose to answer. Only that question may be re-answered.

ResolutionView.title: ResolutionView
ResolutionView.description: How the question's current status was set: a selected option, the user's own words, or left open.

damagedOperations.title: Damagedoperations
damagedOperations.description: Operation records that cannot be read. Model work is refused until each is moved aside.
